title: Anthropic cancelled the planned Sonnet 5 price rise and made $2 / $10 permanent
detail: An increase to $3 input and $15 output per million tokens had been scheduled for September 1, 2026. Anthropic cancelled it on August 11 and kept the launch rate of $2 input and $10 output.
impact: A price rise that was announced and then withdrawn. If you rebudgeted or migrated off Sonnet 5 in anticipation, the reason for that move no longer exists.
